source.description: Initial dev-stream screenshot transcriptions, reconciled against the printed cards in the Shout At Your Decks reveal gallery. Per-printing sourceImageUrl identifies gallery artwork.

notes: Unreleased cards. Do not merge into card-catalog.json, tournament stats, or Card Impact numbers.
Records with sourceImageUrl were checked against gallery artwork for names, costs, types, stats, rules text, collector numbers, and rarities. Other records retain the initial stream transcription.
Cards with null collectorNumber/rarity had unreadable print. Mana-cost orb values were read from the card frame.
Field names and enum values follow data/card-catalog.json (types, subtypes, elements, cost). exalted marks the "Ex" frame badge.
reprintOf: the same card text already exists in the catalog under that set prefix.
Song cards are Unlockable Actions: they can only be registered in an unlockable deck (the Song deck). Opening Refrain is a normal Melody action in Main and copies a card from the Song deck.
image / altPrintings[].image are local image assets in app/public/images/spoilers/. Records with sourceImageUrl use gallery artwork; remaining assets are stream screenshot crops.

sets.CBL: Set prefix printed on cards shown with the Casella and Beatrice reveals
sets.CBLP: Set prefix printed on the Pantheon (boon/devotion) cards

cards.name: Spirit of Wind
cards.effect: On Enter: Draw seven cards.
cards.flavor: Leran believed the wind was an echo of Harmonia's song—as beautiful and sweet as the goddess Herself.

cards.name: Casella, Volant Songstress
cards.effect:
A deck with this card in it unlocks the Song deck. (It's an unordered private deck consisting of a maximum of four different Song cards.)
On Enter: Empower 2.
Inherited Effect — If you would empower an amount, you may put that many aria counters on Casella instead.

cards.name: Casella, Wistful Refrain
cards.effect:
Casella Lineage
On Enter: Empower 2. Then if there are five or more aria counters on Casella, draw a card.
cards.flavor: In doubt, your encouragement keeps me strong.

cards.name: Casella, Sky's Cantatrice
cards.effect:
Casella Lineage
On Enter: Recover X, where X is the amount of arcane element cards in your banishment.
(3), Banish a non-Spirit champion card from Casella's inner lineage: Casella sings.

cards.name: Skyward Requiem
cards.effect:
(Unlockable — This card can only be registered in an unlockable deck.)
On Premiere: Empower 2.
You may remove three aria counters from your champion. If you do, draw a card into your memory.

cards.name: Chromatic
cards.effect:
(Remove two aria counters from your champion to pay for this card's aria cost.)
On Premiere: For each non-exalted element, put a buff counter on up to one ally of that element.
Prevent the next 3 damage that would be dealt to up to one target ally this turn.

cards.name: Aiss Yustera
cards.effect:
On Premiere: The next ally card you activate this turn costs (2) less to activate. (Trigger this ability when you activate "Aiss Yustera" for the first time each game.)
If your influence is seven or less, scavenge 7 for an ally card. (A player's influence is equal to the total amount of cards in their hand and memory.)

cards.name: Let My Thunder Be Heard
cards.effect:
On Premiere: Banish up to three cards from your memory. For each card banished this way, draw a card.
Finale — If there are four or more face up cards in your Song deck, each ally you control gets +X power until end of turn, where X is the amount of arcane element cards in your banishment. X is capped at 6.

cards.name: Opening Refrain
cards.effect:
Draw a card into your memory.
Casella Bonus Casella sings. (You may copy a Song card from your Song deck and activate that copy. If you do, turn the copied card face up if it's face down.)
cards.flavor: It's the opener, I have to make a good impression!

cards.name: Casella's Indomitable Hymn
cards.effect:
Allies you control gain immortality until end of turn. (A unit with immortality can't die.)
Casella Bonus Casella sings. (You may copy a Song card from your Song deck and activate that copy. If you do, turn the copied card face up if it's face down.)

cards.name: ChannelTech Charm S
cards.effect:
On Enter: Draw a card into your memory.
Class Bonus Sacrifice ChannelTech Charm S: Empower 2. (The next Spell card you activate this turn activates and resolves as if your champion got +2 level. Activate this ability only if your champion's class matches this card's class.)

cards.name: Electrostatic Discharge
cards.effect:
Class Bonus This card costs 2 less to activate.
Negate target card activation if that card's reserve cost is less than or equal to X, where X is the amount of arcane element cards in your banishment.
If Electrostatic Discharge was empowered, deal X damage to each champion you don't control.

cards.name: Dielectric Prelate
cards.effect:
Intercept (Whenever your champion is attacked while this ally is awake, you may redirect that attack to this ally.)
Class Bonus On Death: Deal X damage to each ally your opponents control, where X is the amount of arcane element cards in your banishment. X is capped at 4.

cards.name: Final Refrain
cards.effect:
Efficiency (This card costs LV less to activate. LV refers to your champion's level.)
On Enter: Empower 3.
Casella Bonus Whenever one or more aria counters are removed from your champion, deal 1+X damage to target champion you don't control, where X is the amount of counters removed this way.

cards.name: Sapiential Codex
cards.effect:
Class Bonus On Enter: Empower 1.
(3), Banish Sapiential Codex: Draw a card into your memory.
cards.flavor: In a world of digital books, there's just something special about holding one in your hands.

cards.name: Glittering Penlight
cards.effect:
Ally Link
Whenever you activate a Harmony or Melody card, cascade—
1— Linked ally gets +1 POWER until end of turn.
2— Put a buff counter on linked ally.
3— Sacrifice Glittering Penlight and draw a card into your memory.
(This ability changes each cascade.)

cards.name: Sonic Boom, Thunder's Echo
cards.effect: Casella Bonus (3), Banish Sonic Boom: Target opponent banishes a card at random from their memory. Empower X, where X is the reserve cost of the card banished this way. X is capped at 4.
cards.flavor: Every note, echoed in perfect clarity.

cards.name: Spirit of Water
cards.effect: On Enter: Draw seven cards.
cards.flavor: It once fed a burgeoning civilization. Now it cools the servers within the Tower of Dis.

cards.name: Beatrice, Program Architect
cards.effect: Beatrice Bonus Inherited Effect — On Enter: Banish up to two Program cards from your hand and/or memory compiled. Draw a card into your memory for each card banished this way. (You may activate compiled cards from your banishment.)
cards.flavor: If my will to good persists, why should the violence of others cause the measure of my merit to be less?

cards.name: Beatrice, Cybernetic Catalyst
cards.effect:
Beatrice Lineage
On Enter: You may sacrifice a Powercell item or an Automaton ally. If you do, draw a card.
Beatrice Bonus Inherited Effect — You may activate compiled cards as though they had fast activation.

cards.name: Beatrice, Master Directive
cards.effect:
Beatrice Lineage
(2), [rest], Put a compiled card from your banishment into your graveyard: Summon two Servitor tokens. Then if you control seven or more Automaton allies, put a buff counter on each Automaton ally you control.
cards.flavor: For mortals, creation is bound to destruction.

cards.name: Protocol/PROTECTION
cards.effect:
Automaton Ally Link
Linked ally gets +1 LIFE.
If linked ally would be dealt damage, prevent 2 of that damage. Apply this replacement effect only once each turn.

cards.name: Protocol/VIRUS
cards.effect:
Automaton Ally Link
You may have compiled Program cards you activate enter the field as a copy of Protocol/VIRUS.
Linked ally gets +1 POWER and +1 LIFE.
(3), Sacrifice Protocol/VIRUS and two other objects with the same name: Search your deck for a card named Virgilian Prime and put it onto the field. Then shuffle your deck. Activate this ability only if you don't control an ally named Virgilian Prime.

cards.name: Protocol/CLOUD
cards.effect:
Automaton Ally Link
Linked ally has "On Death: Recover 3."
Class Bonus Floating Memory (While paying for a memory cost, you may banish this card from your graveyard to pay for 1 of that cost.)

cards.name: Protocol/AGGRESSION
cards.effect:
Automaton Ally Link
Linked ally gets +1 POWER.
On Enter: Linked ally's next attack this turn gets +2 POWER.
cards.flavor: VIRUS DETECTED. Threat level: CRITICAL.

cards.name: Protocol/REFACTOR
cards.effect:
Automaton Ally Link
Linked ally has "On Death: Summon two Servitor tokens."
cards.flavor: The nonviable are replaced, not mourned.

cards.name: Protocol/RECURSION
cards.effect:
Automaton Ally Link
Linked ally gets +1 LIFE.
On Enter: You may banish a Program card from your hand or memory compiled. If you do, draw a card into your memory.

cards.name: Protocol/DUPLICATION
cards.effect:
Automaton Ally Link
On Enter: Summon a token copy of linked ally.
cards.flavor: What has been accomplished once can always be replicated again—even miracles. — Beatrice Othniel

cards.name: Virgilian Prime
cards.effect:
Taunt, Vigor
On Enter: Link any amount of Program phantasias with Automaton ally link to Virgilian Prime. Then put any amount of Program phantasia cards with Automaton ally link from your hand, memory, and/or graveyard onto the field linked to Virgilian Prime.
(2), Sacrifice a Program linked to Virgilian Prime: As a Spell, deal 5 damage to target unit.

cards.name: Hypothermic Biroid
cards.effect:
Class Bonus Taunt
On Champion Hit: The hit opponent recollects two less cards during the resolution of their next recollection phase. (They choose which cards to recollect.)

cards.name: Hiemal Droid
cards.effect:
Class Bonus Taunt
On Enter: You may banish a Program card or a card with floating memory from your graveyard. If a Program card was banished this way, it becomes compiled. If a card with floating memory was banished this way, draw a card.

cards.name: Modular Armaton
cards.effect: As long as Modular Armaton is linked to two or more objects, Modular Armaton has cleave. (A unit with cleave attacks all objects a chosen opponent controls, and their attacks can't be intercepted.)

cards.name: DisCorp Retainer
cards.effect: As long as DisCorp Retainer is linked to two or more objects, DisCorp Retainer has "On Leave: Draw a card into your memory."
cards.flavor: Have you seen our latest products? I'd be happy to assist you with a recommendation!

cards.name: Collateral Overload
cards.effect:
Beatrice Bonus While paying for this card's reserve cost, you may sacrifice an Automaton ally to pay for 3 of that cost.
Deal 3 damage to target unit.
cards.flavor: Those lost to progress will not be forgotten.

cards.name: Override Access
cards.effect:
As an additional cost to activate this card, put a compiled card from your banishment into your graveyard.
Choose one—
• Negate target trigger or action card activation that targets an Automaton ally you control.
• If your champion or an Automaton ally you control is defending, end the combat phase.

cards.name: DisCorp Administrator Card
cards.effect: Banish DisCorp Administrator Card: The next two DisCorp cards you activate this turn cost 1 less to activate.
cards.flavor: An administrative identification card that grants only the highest tier of access within DisCorp.

cards.name: Surveillance Module
cards.effect:
Automaton allies you control have true sight. (They can attack objects with stealth.)
(2), Banish Surveillance Module: Summon a Powercell token rested.
cards.flavor: Always watching, always listening, to keep you safe.

cards.name: Machine Replicator
cards.effect: Class Bonus (1), [rest]: Summon a token copy of target token Automaton ally you control with reserve cost 1 or less.
cards.flavor: A machine to replicate machines. Forging a future free of scarcity.

cards.name: Divergent Horizon
cards.effect:
Exalted Resonance (As long as another player has the exalted element enabled, you may play this card ignoring its exalted elemental requirement.)
Draw a card into your memory. Until end of turn, advanced element cards cost (2) more to activate.

cards.name: Spellshield: Double
cards.effect:
(Exalted — This element is enabled for you as long as you have another advanced element enabled.)
The next two times your champion would be dealt damage this turn, prevent that damage.
cards.flavor: Hm, is that the best you can do?

cards.name: Chains of Absolution
cards.effect:
Class Bonus This card costs 2 less to activate.
Negate target non-attack card activation.
Class Bonus Level 7+: Banish the card that had its activation negated this way. As long as that card remains banished, cards its owner activates with the same name as the banished card cost (4) more to activate.

cards.name: Stirred Sentiments
cards.effect:
Active Memory (While paying for a memory cost, you may sacrifice this object to pay for 1 of that cost.)
On Enter: Recover 2. (To recover, remove that many damage counters from your champion.)
cards.flavor: Received memory transfer from Babelia network.

cards.name: HyperRAM Hydroid
cards.effect:
Active Memory (While paying for a memory cost, you may sacrifice this object to pay for 1 of that cost.)
Class Bonus Floating Memory (While paying for a memory cost, you may banish this card from your graveyard to pay for 1 of that cost.)

cards.name: Casella's Poise
cards.effect:
Active Memory (While paying for a memory cost, you may sacrifice this object to pay for 1 of that cost.)
Casella Bonus On Enter: Casella sings.
cards.flavor: Her natural charisma was undeniable. Seeing her on stage made it impossible not to be a fan.

cards.name: Sinister Divulgence
cards.effect: Choose a non-damage counter on target champion you don't control. Remove X of those counters from that champion, where X is half the amount of those counters on that champion, rounded up. X is capped at 4.
cards.flavor: The little songbird has yet to outgrow her cage.

cards.name: Mindfrost
cards.effect:
Class Bonus Target opponent recollects two less cards during the resolution of their next recollection phase. (They choose which cards to recollect.)
Draw a card into your memory.
cards.flavor: Let me put your mind at ease.

cards.name: Evil Claw-Calcabrina
cards.effect:
Vigor
Beatrice Bonus On Enter: Choose one—
• Summon a Neos Essence token.
• You may sacrifice an object named Neos Essence. When you do, if target opponent has influence eight or more, they banish two cards at random from their memory.

cards.name: Neos Essence
cards.effect: Active Memory (While paying for a memory cost, you may sacrifice this object to pay for 1 of that cost.)
cards.flavor: The very essence of creation, ready to become whatever its master wills it to be.

cards.name: Feed the Hungry
cards.effect: You and another target player each summon a Delicious Pastry token. Then you gain the Crowd's Favor status.
cards.flavor: A selfless act that wins the hearts of everyone around.

cards.name: Show Devotion
cards.effect: Draw a card. If you are devoted, draw another card. (A player is devoted as long as they have two or more boons from the same god or aspect in their pantheon.)
cards.flavor: It is belief that manifests strength, both for gods and their believers.

cards.name: Extract Consciousness
cards.effect: Target opponent banishes a card at random from their memory. If you are devoted to Faust, each other opponent also banishes a card at random from their memory. (A player is devoted to Faust as long as they have two or more of Faust's boons in their pantheon.)

cards.name: Gusty Fan
cards.effect: As long as you've activated a Harmony or Melody card this turn, Gusty Fan gets +2 POWER.
cards.flavor: “Check out these custom penlights I made—What do you mean they’re not allowed in the venue?!”

cards.name: Tailwind Vestal
cards.effect: Class Bonus On Enter: Empower 3. (The next Spell card you activate this turn activates and resolves as if your champion got +3 level. Apply this effect only if your champion’s class matches this card’s class.)
cards.flavor: “Harmonia, guide us.”

song.description: Unordered private deck unlocked by Casella, Volant Songstress. Maximum of four different Song cards. Registered like Main or Material, but only in an unlockable deck.
